summary_en: UP GARAGE GROUP will acquire 800,000 shares (10.08% of issued shares excluding treasury stock) via public tender offer at a discounted price from its controlling shareholder E&E. The acquisition aims to enhance EPS and ROE while supporting shareholder returns aligned with the mid-term management plan targeting a 40% dividend payout ratio.
title_en: Notice of Acquisition of Treasury Stock and Public Tender Offer for Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief:
On November 6, 2026, UP GARAGE GROUP resolved to acquire 800,000 shares (10.08% of issued shares excluding treasury stock) from its controlling shareholder E&E via public tender offer. The acquisition responds to E&E's intention, communicated in May 2026, to liquidate part of its holding. The company determined that a public tender offer method best serves shareholder interests by providing a consideration period to other shareholders and enabling a discounted acquisition price compared to market rates, thereby minimizing capital outflow while supporting EPS and ROE improvement.

The company evaluated three methods—public tender offer, market purchases, and ToSTNeT-3 transactions—and concluded that the public tender offer uniquely offers equal treatment among shareholders, transaction transparency, and economic efficiency through a negotiated discount to market price. Market purchases and off-exchange transactions are constrained by regulation to market-based pricing without discount flexibility.

The acquisition aligns with the company's capital policy framework established through bylaw provisions allowing board discretion on dividends and share repurchases to respond flexibly to changing business environments. The company has historically prioritized consistent annual dividends; this marks the first self-share acquisition under board resolution. The acquisition is expected not to materially impact financial position or dividend policy. For FY2027, the company maintains its stated dividend of 36.50 yen per share (37.0% payout ratio), with medium-term target progression toward 40% under the mid-term management plan (FY2025–FY2029) covering growth investments and enhanced shareholder returns.
